vector_memory.semantic_summary: EngineManager serves as the central orchestration layer responsible for managing the lifecycle of various AI model engines. It acts as a factory and validation gatekeeper, abstracting model loading complexity by checking system configuration for engine installation status. Its core methods handle configuration loading, saving, and the dispatching of model instantiation based on the specified model type (e.g., GGUF, OpenAI, Gemini). It manages interactions with the filesystem and handles specific runtime errors like GpuMemoryError.
